request.description: Generates presigned single-shot PUT upload URLs for result media (EC8A photo form and/or optional video evidence). The frontend uploads raw file binaries directly to S3/R2 using HTTP PUT with the matching `Content-Type`, then submits the returned `fileKey`s in `Submit Result` (`ec8aPhotoKey`, `videoKey`).
Submits a result for a polling unit. Media fields (ec8aPhotoKey and videoKey) are optional.
